The Unlimited Plan allows unlimited high-speed data, but after 50 GB, priority may decrease during network congestion. Both Internet 100 and Fiber 1000 home plans have no monthly data caps, with Fiber 1000 offering symmetric 1 Gbps download/upload speeds. Please let us know if you need more details!
